patterns.prevention:
• Audit all assigned coaches this week for engagement level and energy—flag any underperforming coaches before centers notice and cancel.

• Confirm backup coach availability at each center so transitions don't create gaps when primary coaches leave or underperform.

• Brief all coaches on the expectation that they communicate their long-term commitment upfront—no surprises about departure timelines to clients.

• Schedule check-ins with centers after coach changes or first 3 sessions with new coaches to catch dissatisfaction early.
